forces.title: Payments value shifting to invisible software infrastructure and trust layer
forces.description: As traditional checkout moments disappear into software, payments value is fundamentally relocating from visible customer interfaces to the invisible infrastructure of trust. This shift prioritizes credentials, consent, identity, dynamic routing, and policy control, creating new demands and revenue streams for specialized software companies (IN080201, IN080202).
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: Agentic AI drives new software for payment optimization and dynamic routing
forces.description: Autonomous software agents are emerging as key players, acting on behalf of consumers and corporations to optimize account yields, dynamically route transactions for minimal fees or maximum rewards, and automate purchasing decisions. This creates significant new demand for advanced application software (IN080201) and the underlying cloud infrastructure (IN080202) to support these capabilities.
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: Hyperscaler capital expenditures boost Cloud & Internet Infrastructure
forces.description: Major hyperscalers are planning cumulative capital expenditures of $800 billion for 2026 and $1 trillion for 2027, with the vast majority allocated to AI infrastructure. This massive investment directly drives substantial demand for compute, storage, and networking as consumption services within the Cloud & Internet Infrastructure segment (IN080202) across global markets including Europe.
forces.source_title: The $2.3 trillion horizon: How AI is rewriting the semiconductor story

forces.title: Growing market for embedded payments and vertical SaaS platforms
forces.description: The payments sector is experiencing incremental gross profit expansion increasingly concentrated in software and workflow layers. Software-led acquirers and vertical SaaS platforms now derive 40-60% of their total gross profit from embedded payments, value-added services, and software subscriptions, indicating robust growth for Application Software (IN080201) in Europe.
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: AI-driven maintenance tools for asset-heavy industries create efficiency
forces.description: Agentic AI solutions are being increasingly embedded into the daily workflows of reliability engineers, planners, and technicians in asset-heavy industries. These tools significantly increase productivity (e.g., 20-fold for reliability engineers), reduce downtime, and optimize spare parts management, creating substantial new demand for specialized application software (IN080201).
forces.source_title: Maintenance meets AI: A proven approach for asset-heavy industries

forces.title: Europe's emerging opportunity in enterprise AI application layer
forces.description: Europe is establishing itself as a key region for AI application layer development, particularly in vertical and industry-specific AI. This is driven by start-ups embedding products deeply into enterprise systems and specializing in Europe's strong industrial ecosystems, supported by favorable structural factors, indicating a significant shift and opportunity for Application Software (IN080201).
forces.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity

forces.title: Data centre buildout and technology investment boosting Norwegian activity
forces.description: Norges Bank's Regional Network contacts anticipate that data centre buildout and broader technology investment will significantly increase activity and accelerate growth in Norway's service sector through 2026 and 2027. This directly translates to increased demand for Cloud & Internet Infrastructure (IN080202) services and related technology solutions in the region.
forces.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

forces.title: Energy availability and cost constraints for European AI data centers
forces.description: AI data centers are inherently energy-intensive, and Europe faces a potential challenge in overcoming current power constraints, including cost-related issues, compared to other regions. This could act as a headwind, potentially slowing the expansion and operation of Cloud & Internet Infrastructure (IN080202) necessary for AI growth in Europe.
forces.source_title: The $2.3 trillion horizon: How AI is rewriting the semiconductor story

forces.title: AI creating new business for Norwegian consultancy and solution implementation
forces.description: The emergence of Artificial Intelligence is driving new business opportunities for Norwegian consultancy firms specializing in AI advisory and solution implementation services. This directly contributes to the adoption and deployment of Application Software (IN080201) and related technologies as businesses seek to leverage AI capabilities, despite some displacement of traditional services.
forces.source_title: Regional Network report 3/2026: Minor changes in growth prospects

forces.title: Shift to embedded software workflows in Dutch retail for omnichannel excellence
forces.description: Dutch multichannel retailers are increasingly strengthening their digital capabilities through investments in websites, mobile apps, and logistics networks, aiming for a seamless omnichannel experience. This trend drives significant demand for application software (IN080201) that supports customer loyalty programs, local fulfillment, and integrated digital services, enhancing competitive advantage.
forces.source_title: Revenue growth masks growing pressure on retail profitability in the Netherlands

forces.title: New product opportunities in payments trust infrastructure for software providers
forces.description: The transition to agentic payments is creating new, lucrative revenue pools for software and cybersecurity firms specializing in trust infrastructure. This includes developing solutions for agent credentials, mandate and consent management, real-time risk controls, agent wallets, and transaction protection frameworks, offering defensible and profitable margin structures beyond traditional processing fees (IN080201, IN080203).
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: Increased IT expenditures in payments sector outpaces revenue growth
forces.description: Information technology expenditures in the global payments sector are projected to compound at roughly 9% annually through 2030, significantly outpacing the moderate 4% global payments revenue growth. This financial imbalance underscores the critical and growing role of IT, including software and cloud services (IG0802), in supporting innovation and operational efficiency within the industry.
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

forces.title: Growing demand for real-time machine authentication and policy verification
forces.description: As explicit user checkpoints disappear in agentic commerce, fraud detection must move deeper into payment rails, relying on continuous machine authentication, behavioral trust scoring, and sub-millisecond policy verification. This is a crucial driver for innovation and adoption of Cybersecurity (IN080203) solutions, particularly those involving identity management and threat intelligence for machine-to-machine transactions.
forces.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

viewpoints.title: Payments value shifts to invisible software infrastructure and control layer
viewpoints.description: As traditional checkouts dissolve into software, payments revenue is relocating from front-end screens to back-end software infrastructure, focusing on trust, machine identity, consent engines, and dynamic routing protocols. Players with strong software capabilities and deep workflow integration are best positioned to capture future value, indicating a positive long-term outlook for specialized software in the payments ecosystem across Europe.
viewpoints.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

viewpoints.title: AI transforms industrial maintenance from cost center into value driver
viewpoints.description: Embedding AI and technology within day-to-day operations is transforming maintenance functions in asset-heavy industries from mere cost centers into significant drivers of value generation. This shift promises increased efficiency, improved equipment availability, and substantial margin improvements, signaling a positive long-term outlook for AI-driven application software in industrial settings across Europe.
viewpoints.source_title: Maintenance meets AI: A proven approach for asset-heavy industries

viewpoints.title: Dutch retail e-commerce growth masks broader profitability pressures for retailers
viewpoints.description: While Dutch retail sales are expected to increase by 3% in 2026, driven by 4.5% e-commerce growth, rising costs and intense price competition are preventing sales growth from translating into higher profits for many retailers. This indicates a cautious outlook for the overall retail sector, which could indirectly affect software providers serving these businesses if profitability challenges persist.
viewpoints.source_title: Revenue growth masks growing pressure on retail profitability in the Netherlands

viewpoints.title: AI permanently reshaping semiconductor market, fueling AI infrastructure demand
viewpoints.description: The unprecedented surge in semiconductor demand, primarily fueled by AI and massive capital expenditures from hyperscalers on AI infrastructure, is expected to usher in a period of sustained growth, unlike historical cyclical patterns. This robust demand for advanced chips implies a strong positive outlook for Cloud & Internet Infrastructure (IN080202) services that leverage these high-performance semiconductors.
viewpoints.source_title: The $2.3 trillion horizon: How AI is rewriting the semiconductor story

viewpoints.title: Europe poised for significant growth in AI application layer opportunities
viewpoints.description: Europe is witnessing substantial momentum in venture funding for vertical and industry-specific AI applications, driven by deep product integration into enterprise workflows and specialization in Europe’s industrial ecosystems. Structural factors like reversing AI talent flows and increased corporate investment further reinforce the region's position, signaling a strong positive outlook for European Application Software (IN080201) development and adoption.
viewpoints.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity

new_opportunities.description: The revenue 'at risk' for traditional payment providers represents new opportunities for software companies to provide agentic solutions for financial optimization, account management, and dynamic transaction routing.
new_opportunities.opportunity: Agentic software for payment optimization and dynamic routing

market_sizing.methodology: Baseline scenario for agentic AI adoption in global payments, representing revenue at risk for traditional payment providers. Mechanisms include automatic sweeps of idle cash to higher-yielding accounts ($65 billion) and erosion of consumer credit card revenues ($10 billion) due to payment rail substitution and optimization.
market_sizing.source_title: The 2026 Global Payments Report: Operational excellence in an invisible world

demand_drivers.description: Consumers in the Netherlands have improved purchasing power, supporting spending in e-commerce.
The long-term trend of consumers shifting to online shopping continues, expanding e-commerce market share.

demand_drivers.driver: Strengthened digital capabilities by multichannel retailers
demand_drivers.description: Traditional retailers have invested in websites, mobile apps, and logistics, enabling them to compete more effectively online and driving e-commerce growth.

market_sizing.methodology: Forecasted turnover growth for the Dutch e-commerce sector for 2026.
market_sizing.source_title: Revenue growth masks growing pressure on retail profitability in the Netherlands

demand_drivers.description: European AI start-ups are focusing on embedding products deeply into enterprise systems of record and complex workflows, driving funding and adoption.
A focus on Europe’s historically strong industrial sectors for vertical AI applications is attracting significant investment.

new_opportunities.description: European start-ups focused on the AI application layer reached 44% of comparable US funding levels in 1H26 (up from 11% in 2018), with vertical AI applications attracting 67% of funding compared to US peers (up from 9% in 2018).

market_sizing.methodology: Comparison of venture funding levels for AI start-ups in Europe versus the US, specifically focusing on the application layer and vertical AI applications.
market_sizing.source_title: Europe’s new AI edge? The emerging application layer opportunity
